headline: Sanjay Kirloskar files SEBI Takeover disclosure under Regulation 31(4)
sum: Promoter Sanjay Kirloskar has filed a substantial-acquisition or change-of-control disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4), triggering public-company transparency obligations in a KBL shareholding event.
detail: Sanjay Kirloskar submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This regulation requires disclosure when a promoter or substantial acquirer crosses a threshold shareholding in a listed company. The disclosure was filed on or before 19 June 2026. The identity of the acquirer (Sanjay Kirloskar) and the target (Kirloskar Brothers Limited, a publicly listed industrial conglomerate) are confirmed; the specific shareholding percentage, acquisition date, and trigger event are not detailed in the Bar & Bench notice but would be stated in the full Regulation 31(4) form filed with NSE.
